comparison_and_acceptance.engineering_gate_rule: A failed runtime, alignment, oracle, positive-control, or reproducibility gate is an invalid pipeline, not a negative scientific finding.

frozen_mvp_criteria.U1_green: A contiguous band of at least two layers has held-out R2 greater than zero, beats last-seen, and beats grouped shuffle at p<0.01.
frozen_mvp_criteria.U2_green: Partial correlation of decoded/oracle spread controlling tau has a hierarchical 95% bootstrap CI above zero; average absolute 50/80/95% coverage error is at most 0.10 and improves on time-only and visible-history-q baselines.
frozen_mvp_criteria.U3_green: Positive hidden-time growth, decoded/oracle slope ratio in [0.5, 2.0], and a reveal decrease with CI below zero and median spread reduction of at least 25%.

decision_rule.GREEN: Engineering gates pass; U1 and U2 are green; U3 is directionally correct.
decision_rule.RED: Runtime, alignment, oracle, positive control, detector, or reproduction fails; do not interpret negative science.
decision_rule.YELLOW: Engineering and controls pass, but a frozen scientific criterion fails cleanly; report the valid alternative result.

positive_control_override.rule: The exact completed Phase 6 decision is controlling; this handoff does not reapply the older planning-only R2 threshold.
